evidence.query_passage:
Alice was beginning to get very tired of sitting by her sister on the bank, and of having nothing to
do: once or twice she had peeped into the book her sister was reading, but it had no pictures or
conversations in it, "and what is the use of a book," thought Alice "without pictures or
conversations?" So she was considering in her own mind (as well as she could, for the hot day
made her feel very sleepy and stupid), whether the pleasure of making a daisy-chain would be
worth the trouble of getting up and picking the daisies, when suddenly a White Rabbit with pink
eyes ran close by her.

evidence.query_passage: After a city removes library fines, the outstanding debt disappears, so apparent improvement in account balances says nothing about whether books come back sooner. Measure days overdue among loans issued after the change instead. Compare the same calendar weeks with a neighbouring council that keeps its old rules, because school holidays can alter borrowing. Keep replacement charges unchanged during the experiment so the policy contrast is interpretable. Success means shorter delays in returning books without fewer loans to residents who previously owed money.
evidence.matched_passage: The useful outcome is how late newly borrowed volumes are returned. An adjacent authority retaining penalties provides a comparison over corresponding weeks, helping separate the reform from seasonal school closures. Liability for lost items should stay constant while overdue fees are tested.
